---

### **14-Day Beginner Machine Learning Learning Plan**

#### **Day 1: Introduction to Machine Learning and Python Basics**
- **Theory:**
  - What is machine learning? Overview of supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
  - Why Python? Introduction to Python for data science.
- **Practical:**
  - Install Python and Jupyter Notebook.
  - Write your first Python script: print, variables, loops, and functions.
- **Resources:**
  - [Python for Beginners - Coursera](https://www.coursera.org/learn/python-for-beginners) (Free Introductory Course)
  - [Python Official Documentation](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/)

---

#### **Day 2: Python for Data Science**
- **Theory:**
  - NumPy: Arrays, slicing, and basic operations.
  - Pandas: DataFrames, Series, and basic operations.
- **Practical:**
  - Create a DataFrame, read a CSV file, and perform basic operations.
- **Resources:**
  - [NumPy Tutorial](https://numpy.org/doc/stable/user/quickstart.html)
  - [Pandas Documentation](https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/user_guide/index.html)

---

#### **Day 3: Data Preprocessing**
- **Theory:**
  - Importing data, handling missing values, and data cleaning.
  - Feature scaling and normalization.
- **Practical:**
  - Load a dataset, handle missing values, and scale features.
- **Resources:**
  - [Data Preprocessing Tutorial (YouTube)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_OvLOS6sBH4)
  - [DataCamp: Data Preprocessing](https://www.datacamp.com/blog/data-preprocessing)

---

#### **Day 4: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)**
- **Theory:**
  - Understanding distributions, visualizing data with Matplotlib and Seaborn.
- **Practical:**
  - Perform EDA on a dataset (e.g., Iris dataset) using histograms, scatter plots, and box plots.
- **Resources:**
  - [Seaborn Tutorial](https://seaborn.pydata.org/tutorial.html)

---

#### **Day 5: Introduction to Supervised Learning**
- **Theory:**
  - What is supervised learning? Types of supervised learning problems (regression, classification).
- **Practical:**
  - Split data into training and testing sets.
- **Resources:**
  - [Supervised Learning - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/machine-learning/supervised-machine-learning/)

---

#### **Day 6: Linear Regression**
- **Theory:**
  - What is linear regression? Cost function, gradient descent.
- **Practical:**
  - Implement linear regression using scikit-learn on a simple dataset.
- **Resources:**
  - [scikit-learn Linear Regression](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.linear_model.LinearRegression.html)

---

#### **Day 7: Classification Algorithms (Logistic Regression)**
- **Theory:**
  - What is logistic regression? Sigmoid function, decision boundary.
- **Practical:**
  - Implement logistic regression on a classification dataset (e.g., Iris dataset).
- **Resources:**
  - [Logistic Regression - scikit-learn](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.linear_model.LogisticRegression.html)

---

#### **Day 8: Model Evaluation Metrics**
- **Theory:**
  - Accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, confusion matrix.
- **Practical:**
  - Evaluate a classification model using these metrics.
- **Resources:**
  - [Model Evaluation Metrics - Analytics Vidhya](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/blog/2019/08/11-important-model-evaluation-error-metrics/)

---

#### **Day 9: Decision Trees**
- **Theory:**
  - How decision trees work, splitting criteria (Gini, entropy).
- **Practical:**
  - Train a decision tree classifier on a dataset.
- **Resources:**
  - [Decision Trees - scikit-learn](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.tree.DecisionTreeClassifier.html)

---

#### **Day 10: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)**
- **Theory:**
  - How KNN works, choosing the right K.
- **Practical:**
  - Implement KNN for classification and regression.
- **Resources:**
  - [KNN - scikit-learn](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.neighbors.KNeighborsClassifier.html)

---

#### **Day 11: Introduction to Unsupervised Learning**
- **Theory:**
  - What is unsupervised learning? Clustering vs. dimensionality reduction.
- **Practical:**
  - Explore clustering concepts.
- **Resources:**
  - [Unsupervised Learning with Python - Built In](https://builtin.com/data-science/unsupervised-learning-python)

---

#### **Day 12: K-Means Clustering**
- **Theory:**
  - How K-means works, inertia, silhouette score.
- **Practical:**
  - Implement K-means clustering on a dataset.
- **Resources:**
  - [K-Means - scikit-learn](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.cluster.KMeans.html)

---

#### **Day 13: Revision and Recap**
- **Theory:**
  - Recap all topics covered in the first 12 days.
- **Practical:**
  - Review code snippets and concepts.
- **Resources:**
  - Revisit previous tutorials and documentation.

---

#### **Day 14: Mini Project**
- **Project:**
  - Choose a dataset (e.g., Iris, Titanic, or a dataset of your choice).
  - Perform data preprocessing, train a supervised or unsupervised model, and evaluate it.
  - Write a short report summarizing your findings.
- **Example Project Ideas:**
  - Predict house prices using linear regression.
  - Classify iris flowers using KNN or decision trees.
  - Cluster customer data using K-means.

---

This plan ensures a balanced mix of theory and practical exercises, covering all the required topics and reserving the final two days for revision and a project.
